diagnosis_summary: The Obsidian and WebForms Site Detail creation paths created a website InteractionChannel without setting UsesSession, so the non-nullable Boolean retained its false default. Commit d479c05 explicitly sets UsesSession to true in both creation paths. The change affects newly created channels and does not include a migration for existing website interaction channels. The issue is labeled Fixed in v19.4; verify exact package inclusion because a release-line label is not an exact build attestation.
workaround_summaries: Use a Rock build proven to contain commit d479c05fef99cc57121bd5786ca00f36c7a0b7de before creating new websites. Upgrading does not migrate existing channels, so inspect channels created on earlier builds separately. No source-reviewed supported bulk-repair path was identified; do not apply direct database updates as a substitute for a reviewed Rock administration path.

verification_playbook.goal: Determine whether the installed creation path contains the fix and whether an existing website interaction channel still has Uses Session disabled.
prerequisites: Know which site and website interaction channel are paired.
Have read-only access to interaction-channel configuration.

steps.title: Check build ancestry
steps.instructions: Confirm whether the installed package contains commit d479c05fef99cc57121bd5786ca00f36c7a0b7de, which sets UsesSession to true in both Site Detail creation paths.
steps.expected_if_affected: The installed build predates the creation-path fix or has not been independently verified to contain an equivalent change.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: The installed build contains the fixing commit or an independently verified equivalent implementation for newly created channels.

steps.title: Inspect the paired interaction channel
steps.instructions: View the website Interaction Channel without saving and record only whether Uses Session is enabled. Do not record channel IDs, site domains, visitor data, or interaction records.
steps.expected_if_affected: The paired website channel exists and Uses Session is disabled.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: Uses Session is enabled, or the site does not use a website interaction channel created by this path. A fixed build alone does not establish this for pre-upgrade channels.
evidence_to_record: website channel present yes or no
Uses Session enabled yes or no

limitations: A disabled setting confirms local exposure to the reported configuration, but it does not by itself quantify analytics impact or establish a supported remediation path.
The fixing commit changes creation behavior only; it does not migrate channels created before the fix.

context.scope: new web sites whose website interaction channel is created by Site Detail
exact Site Detail source revision for newly created website interaction channels; existing rows are not migrated
official fix release line for newly created channels; verify the exact installed package and inspect existing channels separately
